FN-6YJXL11-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 24
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/13/2026
Senate Bill 24 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Board of
Pardons and Paroles (BPP) and the Secretary of State (SOS) to: (1) jointly develop and make
available on each agency's respective website a form and instructions to aid individuals seeking
to have their voting rights restored; and (2) make the notifications required pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
